Our engineering team lives at the intersection of high-performance DSP design, system modeling, and optical innovation.</p><p></p><p><b>How You Will Contribue:</b></p><p>We are seeking a highly skilled Senior SerDes System/DSP Design Engineer to join our advanced engineering team . In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and validation of high-speed serial transceivers across electrical and optical domains. You will leverage your expertise in systems engineering, control theory, DSP algorithms, and modeling to develop cutting-edge serial electrical/optical-IMDD transceiver solutions.</p><p></p><p>This position offers the opportunity to work on industry-leading designs at the intersection of electrical SerDes technology and advanced optical communications, driving innovations that enable next-generation high-capacity networks.</p><ul><li>Lead the design and development of electrical SerDes DSP architectures for high-speed data communication systems.</li><li>Perform system-level maximum likelihood sequence detection (MLSD), and timing recovery algorithms.</li><li>Integrate control theory and advanced DSP designs into feasible hardware implementations.</li><li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (analog design, ASIC design, electro-optical hardware, firmware) to optimize SerDes performance in end-to-end systems.</li><li>Conduct design trade-offs to meet stringent performance, power, and area targets.</li><li>Analyze channel models, analog circuits impairments (DAC, ADC, AFE, …) and system constraints to determine system level margin and FEC (forward error correction) performance and optimize system margin.</li><li>Provide system level specifications for different sub-blocks of SerDes transceivers such as DAC, ADC, AFE, PLL.</li><li>Evaluate and model IMDD optical links and formulate strategies to enhance system robustness.</li><li>Document design specifications, system performance results, and contribute to IP generation and innovation roadmaps.</li></ul><p></p><p><b>The Must Haves</b></p><ul><li>Advanced expertise in electrical SerDes DSP design and implementation.</li><li>Proven experience in SerDes system-level evaluation, modeling, and simulation.</li><li>Strong proficiency in control theory and digital signal processing (DSP) applied to high-speed communication systems.</li><li>Familiarity with optical IMDD (Intensity Modulation Direct Detection) systems.</li><li>Deep understanding of adaptive equalization techniques for high-speed links.</li><li>Proficiency with maximum likelihood sequence detection (MLSD) approaches.</li><li>Expertise in timing recovery schemes in high-speed serial links.</li><li>Practical knowledge of FEC performance modeling and system-level performance optimization.</li><li>Experience with MATLAB, Python, or C/C&#43;&#43; for algorithm design and simulation.</li><li>Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across hardware/software boundaries.</li><li>Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with background in digital communications and signal processing.</li><li>8&#43; years of experience in high-speed serial link or communication system design.</li></ul><p></p><p><b>Nice to Haves:</b></p><ul><li>Knowledge of industry standards such as PCIe, IEEE, Ethernet, or OIF standards for optical communication.</li><li>Hands-on experience
